newsitem.title: USA: Imation says buys privately-held Imaginet.
newsitem.headline: Imation says buys privately-held Imaginet.

text.p: Imation Corp said Wednesday it has acquired Imaginet Inc, a privately-owned provider of Internet services to manufacturing and service-based companies.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.
Imation said it does not expect any impact to its revenues, income and earnings per share in 1997 as a result of this acquisition.
Imation said it it has created Imation Internet Services, a new business that uses the technology development capabilities of Imaginet.
Scott Litman, president of Imaginet, will head the new Imation business.
